```python
def solve(case):
    nodes = case["nodes"]
    required_symbols = set(case["required_symbols"])
    
    # Validate required fields
    for node in nodes:
        for field in ["id", "parent", "symbol", "depth", "removable"]:
            if field not in node:
                raise ValueError(f"Missing field {field} in node")
    
    # Build lookup structures
    node_by_id = {n["id"]: n for n in nodes}
    
    # Build children map
    children = {n["id"]: [] for n in nodes}
    for n in nodes:
        if n["parent"] is not None:
            children[n["parent"]].append(n["id"])
    
    # Start with all nodes retained
    retained = set(n["id"] for n in nodes)
    
    # Get removable candidates sorted by depth desc, then id asc
    candidates = sorted(
        [n for n in nodes if n["removable"]],
        key=lambda n: (-n["depth"], n["id"])
    )
    
    removed_order = []
    
    for node in candidates:
        nid = node["id"]
        if nid not in retained:
            continue  # already removed (shouldn't happen in normal flow, but safety check)
        
        # Check: node has no retained children
        if any(child in retained for child in children[nid]):
            continue
        
        # Check: all required symbols remain if we remove this node
        # Current retained minus this node
        new_retained_symbols = set(
            node_by_id[rid]["symbol"] for rid in retained if rid != nid
        )
        if required_symbols.issubset(new_retained_symbols):
            retained.remove(nid)
            removed_order.append(nid)
    
    return {
        "removed_node_ids": removed_order,
        "retained_node_ids": sorted(retained)
    }
```
